annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1107 laying down common specifications for certain class D in vitro diagnostic medical devices in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2017/746
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1107 laying down common specifications for certain class D in vitro diagnostic medical devices in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2017/746
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 178
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation setting common specifications for performance evaluation of class D in vitro diagnostic devices (blood grouping, HIV, HTLV, hepatitis, vCJD, CMV, EBV, syphilis, T. cruzi, SARS-CoV-2) under Regulation 2017/746. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets common specifications for performance characteristics of class D IVD devices where harmonised standards are lacking.
Devices conforming to Decision 2002/364/EC or this Regulation are presumed conforming from 25 July 2022 to 25 July 2024.
Applies from 25 July 2024; Article 3 applies from 25 July 2022.
Annexes specify specimen numbers and acceptance criteria for sensitivity and specificity.
Self-tests require evaluation by lay persons.
